title: Consciousness is the subjective form of a contrast, the crown of experience

statements.text: Consciousness arises in intellectual feelings: it is the subjective form of feeling the contrast between what is in fact and what might be. It flickers, lights a small focal region within a large dim region of experience, and is the crown of experience, only occasionally attained, not its necessary base.

sources.quote: The subjective form of the feeling of this contrast is consciousness.
consciousness is the crown of experience, only occasionally attained, not its necessary base
